text: Code says "space" for spaces and "graph" only for the drawn canvas: internal rename, old MCP names dropped
description: Felix 2026-11-24: "the internal field names... if it's about spaces, name them spaces. Otherwise that's a technical debt that will cause confusion." "The dual meaning of graph in this codebase is why we renamed to space in the first place." Also: drop the old MCP names (graph, projectPath) instead of keeping aliases.

status.comment: 41579c29. Inventory + mapping table + script: 229 distinct graph-names classified as space or canvas; bare graph/graphs kept only in canvas files and value-calculation (the flow graph). tRPC field graph → space, routers spaces/space/spaceHealth, registry Space, files graphs/ → spaces/ etc. Kept as graph: the canvas (GraphView, simulation, WebGL renderer, graphUIStore, view mode 'graph'). Offers: offeredSpace. MCP aliases graph/projectPath dropped. Server files migrate once at startup (renameGraphsToSpaces, idempotent): graphs.json, server.json limits, accounts.json rights and token scopes, guest notes offers. .bowman format unchanged. Out of scope: meta/, education/, math/, wrapped-agents benchmarks. Evidence: pnpm check 25/25 (Node 22) incl. new migration test; this record written through the reconnected MCP. Remaining: deploy ideas.entour.fyi and the Commons Hub server together.
